## Change

Describe one improvement or fix and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] The applicable [minimum validation](https://github.com/carlosciller/AirCiller/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#minimum-validation) passes: documentation review and diff checks for prose-only changes, or `./Scripts/check.sh` for code, dependencies and build changes.
- [ ] Does not modify originals or transcode silently.
- [ ] Does not include media, personal paths, IP addresses, receivers, or credentials.
- [ ] Distinguishes local tests, receiver state, digital capture and physical observation; identifies any missing applicable checks.
- [ ] If playback is affected, the relevant cases in [Testing](https://github.com/carlosciller/AirCiller/blob/main/TESTING.md) were checked. Shared playback changes and engine upgrades cover direct MP4 and HLS/fMP4 separately.
